headline: Iraq and Egypt Hold Bilateral Talks on Trucking Access, Visas, and Aviation Dues
summary: During the fourth session of the Iraqi-Egyptian Higher Joint Committee, representatives discussed Egyptian truck transit access through Iraq, visa exemptions for maritime crew, and settling Iraqi Airways financial obligations in Egyptian pounds.
why: Bilateral joint committees facilitate regional trade agreements and cross-border transport logistics in the Middle East.

impacts.name: Iraq
impacts.why: Iraq and Egypt held talks to resolve bilateral transport, visa, and airline payment issues.
